mapper.delete: DELETE child FROM cut_plan_device child JOIN cut_plan_revision parent ON parent.tenant_id = child.tenant_id AND parent.id = child.plan_revision_id WHERE child.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND child.plan_revision_id = #{query.planRevisionId} AND parent.status_code = 'DRAFT' AND parent.current_marker = 1 AND parent.deleted = b'0'
